issue.title: Link a reference to today from the Bob Refs panel (⌘N)
issue.description: In Bob Mac Capture's Refs panel, ⌘N opens a Link to Today card with the current or next Pomodoro preselected. Return (or a second ⌘N) sets the selected reference's reading task Next and links it under that Pomodoro in today's daily note. Arrows or a typed name pick another Pomodoro or create a new named one. A glass toast confirms exactly what changed. A new `bob ref today` command owns every vault decision through capture's existing-task link planner.

issue.title: bob ref today
issue.description: cli: add `bob ref today <REF>` to bob-cli. It resolves a reference and its v2 reading task, then reuses capture's existing-task Pomodoro link planner and atomic commit. Capture's ledger selection gains exact-name and stale-safe entry-ref targets. The command emits a schema-1 JSON envelope (open Pomodoros with running/default/linked flags plus capture's own pomodoro_link item object) with stable error codes. Ships docs, help text, and parity tests against `bob capture '^route:block-id[#name]'`.

payload.entry: Portable API for mac_ui: BobRefsFetcher.linkToToday(notePath:selector:dryRun:) is concrete only; the UI phase adds the RefsFetching requirement. RefsTodayLinkCard(item:) starts loading; feed the initial automatic dry run (including transport problems wrapped as RefsTodayLinkResponse(ok:false,error:...)) into applyListing. editQuery/select/handle return preview, submit, reload, cancel, or none. For every preview effect, snapshot card.previewRequest BEFORE debounce/await, then call applyPreview(response, for: token); its selector and generation reject stale results including A→B→A and post-submit/cancel responses. Preview transport failures can use the same error envelope plus token. Write failures call fail(problem); stale_pomodoro returns reload and applyListing preserves the query. Row clicks call select(index:) then handle(.submit). RefsTodayLinkPresentation owns row copy/time math/progress, lane chip, preview text, refusal headlines, toast, notifications and announcement. Real CLI fixture provenance is recorded in Tests/Fixtures/refs-today-README.md. No protocol/AppKit changes or memory edits in this phase.

Implemented portable ref-today schema decoding with CaptureCommandSuccess reuse; preview/write fetch lanes and timeouts; pure ranked card state, selector mapping, IME/key handling, stale generation rejection, refusal/failure/reload paths; centralized row/preview/toast/notification/accessibility copy and time math; fake-bob arm and seven scrubbed real CLI fixtures. Verified on athena: just portable-check passed all 1,274 portable tests; after final regression additions and copy consolidation, focused RefsTodayLinkTests + RefsFetchingTests passed 38 tests, with targeted Swift format lint clean. git diff --check and bash -n fake-bob passed. No new Sendable warnings from the response graph. sase bead epic-symbols reports no leftovers. Only portable targets/fixtures changed; no memory edits. API integration notes recorded for mac_ui. Closed only this phase.
